concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-control-panel-duplicate-checking]] — default-enabled gateway duplicate screening for qualifying repeated transaction requests, payment-method-specific matching, immediate rejection behavior, and Account Admin Control Panel configuration boundaries
warnings: Treat the 2026-09-16 raw as collected evidence, not proof of current Braintree support or configuration defaults.
Keep repeated API requests, gateway duplicate screening, and Control Panel configuration distinct; this article does not establish API idempotency-key or SDK retry semantics.
Preserve the immediate-rejection and no-automatic-retry warning for an in-flight initial transaction that is subsequently declined.
Do not generalize the listed matching conditions beyond the payment methods and conditional order/subscription identifiers documented by the article.
